description: Defines data structures and functions related to TDD UL-DL configuration in 5G NR, including patterns, slot calculations, and slot search utilities.

classes.name: tdd_ul_dl_pattern
classes.description: Represents a TDD UL-DL pattern with slot and symbol counts for DL and UL.

classes.name: tdd_ul_dl_config_common
classes.description: Holds common TDD UL-DL configuration parameters including reference SCS and patterns.

methods.name: nof_slots_per_tdd_period
methods.description: Calculates total number of slots in a TDD period based on configuration.

methods.name: nof_full_dl_slots_per_tdd_period
methods.description: Calculates total number of full DL slots in a TDD period.

methods.name: nof_dl_slots_per_tdd_period
methods.description: Calculates total number of slots with DL symbols in a TDD period.

methods.name: nof_full_ul_slots_per_tdd_period
methods.description: Calculates total number of full UL slots in a TDD period.
